task.title: Pause and resume durable workflow runs with exact reasons
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/700 under decision https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/699 by distinguishing an intentional recoverable hold from abandoned work through revision-bound lifecycle events.
acceptance_criteria: Pause an active non-terminal, non-cancelled run with one non-empty exact reason and resume a paused run with separate exact rationale.
Require the caller-observed revision and persist exact current-phase provenance without changing phase or immutable topology.
Reject advancement while paused while preserving explicit cancellation eligibility and restoring advancement only after resume.
Project only current pause state while replay retains both reasons and rejects stale, duplicate, terminal, cancelled, malformed, or misordered history fail closed.

attempts.summary: Established RED pause and resume lifecycle coverage.
attempts.diagnostic: The focused workflow_run_store suite failed because pause and resume reason types, mutations, projected state, and typed lifecycle errors did not exist.
attempts.patch: Added tests for exact reasons and revisions, reopen and list projection, advancement blocking, cancellation while paused, resume eligibility, invalid lifecycle states, and malformed replay provenance.

attempts.summary: Implemented explicit recoverable holds as revision-bound events.
attempts.diagnostic: Separating paused state from unchanged active state made advancement eligibility explicit without inventing scheduling or automatic resume authority.
attempts.patch: Added validated pause and resume reasons, exact-revision mutations, strict event projection, advancement blocking, shared revision and append helpers, ADR-0013, and milestone documentation.

attempts.summary: Recorded an exact-head helper-adoption maintainability finding.
attempts.diagnostic: CodeRabbit substantively verified the behavior and identified that advance and cancel still inline logic now shared by pause and resume through validate_revision and append_run_event.
attempts.patch: Classified the finding as a trivial non-blocking refactor, retained zero unresolved review threads, and preserved it as durable evidence rather than expanding the lifecycle slice after verification.

outcome.summary: Durable workflow runs now expose explicit recoverable pause state with exact rationale, revision safety, blocked advancement, and cancellability while preserving topology and phase.

lessons: An unchanged active aggregate cannot distinguish intentional hold from abandonment; pause must be explicit persisted state.
Pause and resume are phase-preserving lifecycle mutations and therefore need the same exact-revision protection as advancement and cancellation.
Paused runs can remain cancellable without being advanceable because cancellation and phase transition are distinct authorities.
Shared revision and append helpers should be adopted consistently across every exact-revision workflow mutation in a bounded refactor.
Pause and resume grant no execution, scheduling, automatic wake-up, retry, action, provider, tool, actor, timestamp, or permission authority.
